locations.notes: Bookmarks are user data, small JSON, survive a reinstall intact.
Preferences are plain JSON settings — validate they parse before reapplying. Secure Preferences is a tamper-protected blob tied to the old install; skip it.
Login Data / Cookies are DPAPI- or OS-keyring-locked credential blobs — they won't decrypt on the new install and must never be restored blindly. Export passwords via the browser first.
Extensions are remote code sitting in a user-writable dir — a classic persistence spot. Reinstall from the Chrome Web Store; never restore binaries. The app itself reinstalls via Chocolatey.
